q22397.en: Where a special sign says so, the maximum speed limit can be 150 km/h on stretches of motorway with special features.

explain.short: On motorway stretches built for it (for example 3 lanes plus an emergency lane), the road owner can raise the limit to 150 km/h, but only with signs.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'In presenza di apposito segnale' (where a special sign is present): 150 km/h is never the normal limit.

sceneParams.caption: 150 km/h only where signs allow it

q22398.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on motorways is 130 km/h.

explain.short: 130 km/h is the normal maximum on Italian motorways when no sign gives a different limit.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'Salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise): 130 km/h is the default; signs can change it.

q22399.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit in built-up areas is 50 km/h.

explain.short: Inside a town (centro abitato, built-up area) the normal maximum is 50 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'Salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise): signs may set a different limit, but the default is 50 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Town: 50 km/h
lines: Special town roads with signs: 70 km/h

q22400.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit for mopeds is 45 km/h.

explain.short: A moped (ciclomotore) may never go faster than 45 km/h, on any road.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' (mopeds) have their own limit, lower than cars: 45 km/h.

q22401.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit for farm machines and work machines with pneumatic tyres is 40 km/h.

explain.short: Farm machines (macchine agricole) and work machines (macchine operatrici) are slow vehicles: with rubber tyres their limit is 40 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'con pneumatici' (with rubber tyres): with tyres the limit is 40 km/h; machines without tyres go even slower.

sceneParams.caption: Farm and work machines with tyres: 40 km/h

q22402.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on motorways is 110 km/h in rain.

explain.short: Rain makes braking longer, so the motorway limit drops from 130 km/h to 110 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'in caso di pioggia' (in rain): the lower limit applies in any rain, snow or hail.

q22403.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on main out-of-town roads is 90 km/h in hail.

explain.short: Hail is a kind of precipitation (rain, snow, hail), so on main out-of-town roads the limit drops from 110 km/h to 90 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'grandine' (hail) counts like rain or snow: the lower limit applies.

q22404.en: Where special signs say so, the maximum speed limit in built-up areas on roads with special features is 70 km/h.

explain.short: Some town roads are wide and safe (for example with separate carriageways); there signs can allow up to 70 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'In presenza di appositi segnali' (where special signs are present): 70 km/h only with signs, normally it is 50 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Special town roads: 70 km/h only with signs

q22405.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on main out-of-town roads is 110 km/h.

explain.short: A main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale, separate carriageways, blue signs) has a normal limit of 110 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane principali' (main out-of-town roads): 110 km/h; do not mix it up with 90 km/h of secondary roads.

q22406.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on urban roads is 80 km/h.

explain.short: On town roads the normal limit is 50 km/h; even with special signs it can go only up to 70 km/h, never 80 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: '80 km/h' is the wrong number: towns are 50 km/h.

q22407.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit for heavy quadricycles is 70 km/h.

explain.short: Heavy quadricycles (quadricicli non leggeri, small four-wheel vehicles) have their own limit out of town: 80 km/h, not 70 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: '70 km/h' is the wrong number: the quadricycle limit is 80 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h, not 70
lines: Heavy quadricycle out of town: 80 km/h

q22408.en: The maximum speed limit on any motorway is 150 km/h.

explain.short: The normal motorway limit is 130 km/h. 150 km/h is allowed only on some special stretches, and only with signs.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi' (any): 150 km/h is not for every motorway.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway: 130 km/h; 150 only with signs
lines: Only special stretches with signs: 150 km/h

q22409.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit for cars is 110 km/h.

explain.short: Cars (autovetture) follow the normal limit of the road: 110 km/h on a main out-of-town road.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: 'per le autovetture' (for cars): cars use the road's full limit.

sceneParams.caption: Car on a main road: 110 km/h

q22410.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit is 70 km/h for a car towing a 900 kg caravan.

explain.short: A car towing a caravan or trailer is longer and less stable, so outside towns its limit is 70 km/h (80 km/h only on motorways).
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: 'che traina caravan' (towing a caravan): the trailer, not the road, sets the limit.

q22411.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit is 110 km/h for motor vehicles up to 3.5 t.

explain.short: Motor vehicles up to 3.5 t (cars, vans, campers) follow the normal limit of the road: 110 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: 'fino a 3,5t' (up to 3.5 t): light vehicles use the full limit; only heavier ones have lower limits.

q22412.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit for road trains is 70 km/h.

explain.short: A road train (autotreno, a truck pulling a trailer) is very long and heavy: outside towns its limit is 70 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: 'autotreni' (road trains): heavy vehicles with a trailer have the low limit of 70 km/h.

q22413.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit is 100 km/h for trucks with a total mass up to 3.5 t.

explain.short: Trucks (autocarri) up to 3.5 t are light vehicles: they may go 110 km/h like cars, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: up to 3.5 t the limit is 110 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Light truck up to 3.5 t: 110 km/h, not 100

q22414.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit is 100 km/h for campers with a total mass up to 3.5 t.

explain.short: A camper (autocaravan) up to 3.5 t has the same limit as a car: 110 km/h, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: a camper up to 3.5 t uses 110 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Camper up to 3.5 t: 110 km/h, not 100

q22415.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit is 80 km/h for cars with a light trailer.

explain.short: Any car with a trailer, even a light one (rimorchio leggero), may go only 70 km/h outside towns; 80 km/h is the motorway limit.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: '80 km/h' is the wrong number: with a trailer the limit here is 70 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Car with light trailer: 70 km/h, not 80

q22416.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit for motorcycles is 100 km/h.

explain.short: Motorcycles (motocicli) have the same limit as cars: 110 km/h on a main out-of-town road, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: motorcycles use 110 km/h.

q22417.en: On main out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit for cars with a luggage trailer is 100 km/h.

explain.short: A small luggage trailer (carrello appendice) does not count as a real trailer: the car keeps its limit of 110 km/h, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a main out-of-town road (strada extraurbana principale) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 110 km/h, also with a small luggage trailer (carrello appendice). A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train, may go only 70 km/h.
explain.trap: 'carrello appendice' (small luggage trailer) changes nothing: the limit is 110 km/h.

q22418.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 90 km/h for motorcycles.

explain.short: Motorcycles have the same limit as cars: 90 km/h on a secondary out-of-town road.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'motocicli' (motorcycles): no special lower limit, they use the road's limit.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle on a secondary road: 90 km/h

q22419.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 90 km/h for cars with a luggage trailer.

explain.short: A small luggage trailer (carrello appendice) is not a real trailer: the car keeps the normal limit of 90 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'carrello appendice' (small luggage trailer) does not lower the limit.

q22420.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 70 km/h for cars with a trailer for carrying boats or similar.

explain.short: A boat trailer is a real trailer: a car towing it may go only 70 km/h outside towns.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'rimorchio' (trailer): any real trailer brings the car down to 70 km/h.

q22421.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 90 km/h for campers with a total mass up to 3.5 t.

explain.short: A camper (autocaravan) up to 3.5 t has the same limit as a car: 90 km/h here.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'fino a 3,5t' (up to 3.5 t): light campers use the full limit of the road.

q22422.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 90 km/h for trucks with a total mass up to 3.5 t.

explain.short: Trucks (autocarri) up to 3.5 t are light vehicles: same limit as a car, 90 km/h here.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'fino a 3,5t' (up to 3.5 t): only heavier trucks have lower limits.

q22423.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 70 km/h for road trains.

explain.short: A road train (autotreno, truck with trailer) is long and heavy: outside towns its limit is 70 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'autotreni' (road trains): heavy vehicles with a trailer have the low limit of 70 km/h.

q22424.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 70 km/h for mopeds.

explain.short: A moped (ciclomotore) may never go faster than 45 km/h, on any road; 70 km/h is wrong.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '70 km/h' is the wrong number: mopeds are always 45 km/h.

q22425.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 90 km/h for heavy quadricycles.

explain.short: Heavy quadricycles (quadricicli non leggeri, small four-wheel vehicles) have their own lower limit out of town: 80 km/h, not 90 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '90 km/h' is the car limit; quadricycles have their own limit of 80 km/h.

q22426.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 80 km/h for motorcycles.

explain.short: Motorcycles have the same limit as cars: 90 km/h on a secondary out-of-town road, not 80 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '80 km/h' is the wrong number: motorcycles use 90 km/h here.

q22427.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 100 km/h for cars.

explain.short: On a secondary out-of-town road cars may go 90 km/h, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: secondary roads are 90 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Car on a secondary road: 90 km/h, not 100

q22428.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 80 km/h for a car towing a 750 kg caravan.

explain.short: A car towing any caravan or trailer, even a light one, may go only 70 km/h outside towns; 80 km/h is the motorway limit.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '80 km/h' is the wrong number: with a caravan the limit here is 70 km/h.

q22429.en: The maximum speed limit on secondary out-of-town roads is 100 km/h for motor vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: Vehicles up to 3.5 t follow the road's limit, and on a secondary out-of-town road that is 90 km/h, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: secondary roads are 90 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Up to 3.5 t on a secondary road: 90 km/h

q22430.en: On secondary out-of-town roads the maximum speed limit for cars with a luggage trailer is 80 km/h.

explain.short: A small luggage trailer (carrello appendice) is not a real trailer: the car keeps 90 km/h, not 80 km/h.
explain.rule: On a secondary out-of-town road (strada extraurbana secondaria) cars, motorcycles, campers and vans up to 3.5 t may go 90 km/h, also with a carrello appendice. A car with a trailer or caravan, and a road train: 70 km/h. Mopeds: 45 km/h. Heavy quadricycles: 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '80 km/h' is the wrong number: with a carrello appendice it is still 90 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Car with carrello appendice: 90 km/h, not 80

q22431.en: The stickers shown in the picture are put on the back of some categories of vehicles.

explain.short: These round speed stickers go on the back, so drivers behind can see how fast that vehicle may go.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'alcune categorie' (some categories): only some heavy vehicles carry them, not all vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Stickers on the back of some vehicles
lines: Stuck on the back of the vehicle

q22432.en: The stickers shown in the picture show the maximum speeds allowed for the vehicle they are put on.

explain.short: The numbers (60, 80, 100) are that vehicle's own top speeds on the different types of road.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo sul quale sono applicati' (for the vehicle that carries them): they are not limits for you.

sceneParams.caption: The vehicle's own top speeds
lines: One number per type of road

q22433.en: The stickers shown in the picture are put on some buses.

explain.short: Buses are heavy vehicles with their own lower limits, so they carry these speed stickers on the back.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'alcuni autobus' (some buses): buses are among the vehicles that need the stickers.

q22436.en: The stickers shown in the picture are put on trucks with a total mass up to 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: Trucks up to 3.5 t have the same limits as cars, so they need no speed stickers; only heavier ones carry them.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'fino a 3,5 tonnellate' (up to 3.5 tonnes): light trucks do not carry the stickers.

sceneParams.caption: Not on trucks up to 3.5 t
lines: Truck up to 3.5 t: no stickers

q22437.en: The stickers shown in the picture are put on campers with a total mass up to 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: Campers up to 3.5 t have the same limits as cars, so they do not carry speed stickers.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'fino a 3,5 tonnellate' (up to 3.5 tonnes): light campers have no stickers.

sceneParams.caption: Not on campers up to 3.5 t
lines: Camper up to 3.5 t: no stickers

q22438.en: The stickers shown in the picture are put on motorcycles with an engine over 150 cc.

explain.short: Motorcycles have the same limits as cars, so they never carry speed stickers.
explain.rule: Round stickers with numbers (60, 80, 100) on the back of a vehicle show its own top speeds. They go on heavy vehicles: trucks over 3.5 t, buses, road trains, trailers. Never on cars, campers or vans up to 3.5 t, or on motorcycles.
explain.trap: 'motocicli' (motorcycles): the engine size does not matter, motorcycles have no stickers.

q22434.en: Speed must be reduced in mixed traffic (slow and fast vehicles, or animals and pedestrians, using the road).

explain.short: When slow vehicles, animals or people share the road with fast traffic, surprises are more likely, so you must slow down.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'traffico misto' (mixed traffic): different speeds on the same road mean more danger.

q22435.en: You must adjust your speed to the condition of the road surface (holes, uneven surface, wet leaves).

explain.short: Holes, bumps and wet leaves reduce grip and control, so speed must fit the state of the road surface.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'fondo stradale' (road surface): a bad surface needs a lower speed.

sceneParams.caption: Bad road surface: adapt your speed

q22439.en: Speed must be especially low near a junction.

explain.short: At a junction other vehicles and pedestrians can cross your path, so you arrive slowly, ready to stop.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'in prossimità' (near, coming up to): slow down before the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Near a junction: go slowly
lines: Slow down, be ready to stop

q22440.en: Speed must be especially low in narrow passages.

explain.short: Where the road gets narrow (strettoia) there is little space to pass or avoid things, so you go slowly.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'strettoie' (narrow passages) are on the list of places that need extra care.

q22441.en: Speed must be especially low when it is difficult to pass oncoming vehicles.

explain.short: Here 'incrocio' means meeting an oncoming vehicle. If the road is too tight for both, go slowly so you can stop or move aside.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'incrocio con altri veicoli' (meeting other vehicles) means passing oncoming traffic, not a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Hard to pass oncoming cars: go slowly

q22442.en: Speed must be especially low on stretches of road with poor visibility (bends, hill tops).

explain.short: If you cannot see far ahead, you must be able to stop within the distance you can see, so you go slowly.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'manca la visibilità' (no visibility): bends and hill tops (dossi) hide what is coming.

sceneParams.caption: Bends and hill tops: go slowly
lines: Bend or hill top: you cannot see

q22443.en: Speed must be especially low when, because there are no pavements, pedestrians are on the carriageway.

explain.short: Without a pavement (marciapiede) people walk on the road itself, so you must go slowly and keep a wide distance.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'i pedoni occupano la carreggiata' (pedestrians are on the road): they are very exposed, so slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians on the road: go slowly
lines: No pavement: people on the road

q22444.en: You must reduce speed when the road is slippery because of water, snow, ice, leaves or mud.

explain.short: On a slippery road (strada viscida) tyres grip less and braking takes longer, so you must slow down.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'viscida' (slippery): any cause, water, snow, ice, leaves or mud, means slow down.

q22445.en: Speed must be especially low just after sunset.

explain.short: Sunset by itself is not one of the places or situations that call for extra-low speed; you turn on your lights and drive as the road and visibility allow.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'subito dopo il tramonto' (just after sunset) is not on the list; the list is about junctions, narrow points, bends, pedestrians.

sceneParams.caption: Sunset alone: no special slow speed

q22446.en: Speed must be especially low just after a junction.

explain.short: The danger is before and inside the junction. Once you have passed it, you may go back to normal speed.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after) is the trap: the rule says near, before the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Slow BEFORE the junction, not after

q22447.en: You must adjust your speed according to how much of a hurry the driver is in.

explain.short: Speed depends on the road, the traffic, visibility and weather, never on being late.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'fretta del conducente' (the driver's hurry) is never a reason for speed.

sceneParams.caption: Being in a hurry is not a reason

q22448.en: You must keep a speed suited only to your own state of health.

explain.short: Your health matters, but speed must also fit the road, traffic, visibility, weather and the vehicle.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): health is one factor among many, not the only one.

sceneParams.caption: Not only health: road, traffic, weather too

q22449.en: You must always keep a speed above 30 km/h.

explain.short: There is no general minimum speed of 30 km/h; sometimes you must go slower or even stop.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always): a fixed minimum on every road does not exist.

q22450.en: You must reduce speed when you are followed by a scheduled bus.

explain.short: A bus behind you is not a danger in itself; slowing down for no reason could even cause a crash.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'seguiti da un autobus' (followed by a bus) is no reason to slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Bus behind you: no need to slow down

q22451.en: You must adjust your speed to the state of maintenance and cleanliness of the road.

explain.short: A badly kept or dirty road (holes, gravel, oil) gives less grip, so speed must fit its state.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'manutenzione e pulizia' (maintenance and cleanliness): the state of the road is part of choosing speed.

sceneParams.caption: Road state counts: adapt speed
lines: Holes, gravel, dirt on the road

q22452.en: Speed must be reduced in strong side wind.

explain.short: A strong side wind can push the car out of its lane, especially at high speed, so you slow down.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a real danger: slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Strong side wind: slow down
lines: Slow down, hold the wheel firmly

q22453.en: Speed must be reduced when you are dazzled by the sun.

explain.short: When the sun is in your eyes you see much less, so you must slow down.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'abbagliamento' (being dazzled): less visibility means less speed.

sceneParams.caption: Sun in your eyes: slow down
lines: Sun in your eyes: you see less

q22454.en: On motorways and main out-of-town roads, in thick fog with visibility under 100 m, temporary maximum speed limits of no more than 50 km/h can be imposed.

explain.short: In thick fog you can see very little, so on fast roads the authorities can set a temporary limit of 50 km/h or less.
explain.rule: On motorways and main out-of-town roads, when thick fog cuts visibility under 100 m, a temporary limit of at most 50 km/h can be set. Normal limits are 130 km/h and 110 km/h.
explain.trap: 'possono essere imposti' (can be imposed): it is a temporary limit set with signs, not more than 50 km/h.

sceneParams.caption: Thick fog: temporary limit up to 50 km/h

q22455.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit on main out-of-town roads is 100 km/h.

explain.short: The normal limit on a main out-of-town road is 110 km/h, not 100 km/h.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: '100 km/h' is the wrong number: main out-of-town roads are 110 km/h.

q22456.en: Unless signs say otherwise, the maximum speed limit in built-up areas is 60 km/h, valid up to one kilometre after leaving the town.

explain.short: Towns have a 50 km/h limit, and it ends at the end-of-town sign, not 1 km later. Both parts are wrong.
explain.rule: Unless signs say otherwise: motorways 130 km/h (110 in rain or snow), main out-of-town roads 110 km/h (90 in rain or snow), other out-of-town roads 90 km/h, towns 50 km/h. Signs can allow 150 km/h on some motorways and 70 km/h on some town roads.
explain.trap: '60 km/h' and 'fino ad un chilometro dopo' (up to 1 km after) are both invented.

sceneParams.caption: Town: 50 km/h, ends at the town-end sign

q22457.en: You must reduce speed every time you meet an information road sign.

explain.short: Information signs (segnali di indicazione) only give directions or information; they are not a reason to slow down.
explain.rule: Your speed must always fit the road, the traffic, the visibility and the weather. Slow down where danger is likely: junctions, narrow points, bends, hills, pedestrians on the road, a slippery or bad road surface, wind, glare.
explain.trap: 'ogni qualvolta' (every time) and 'di indicazione' (information): information signs give no order to slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Information sign: no need to slow down
